newsitem.title: USA: NHL ICE HOCKEY-STARS SIGN D SHAWN CHAMBERS TO THREE-YEAR DEAL.
newsitem.headline: NHL ICE HOCKEY-STARS SIGN D SHAWN CHAMBERS TO THREE-YEAR DEAL.

text.p: The Dallas Stars made their second significant free-agent signing in as many days Thursday by inking defenceman Shawn Chambers to a three-year contract.
Chambers, who played the last two-plus seasons with the New Jersey Devils, joins veteran goaltender Ed Belfour as free agents to sign with Dallas this week.

The 30-year-old Chambers, considered one of the best two-way defenceman available in the free agent market, had four goals and 17 assists in 73 games with New Jersey last season. He added a goal and six assists in 10 playoff games with the Devils.

Chambers was originally a supplemental draft pick of the Minnesota North Stars in 1987 and also played for the Washington Capitals and Tampa Bay Lightning before joining the Devils midway through the 1994-95 campaign.
Dallas went from last to first in the Central Division this past season only to lose in the first round of the playoffs to the Edmonton Oilers in seven games.

But after posting the second best record in the league with 48 wins and 104 points, the Stars are working in the off-season to add the talent and experience necessary to battle their Western Conference rivals the Stanley Cup champion Detroit Red Wings and the Colorado Avalanche, who finished first overall in the league.
The Devils have lost two defencemen in as many days to free agency after Dave Ellett signed with the Boston Bruins Wednesday.
